logins.title: Brand login requests ({count})
logins.hint: People who signed up as a Brand and said they belong to a brand in our universe. Check the email and approve: the first approved person becomes the brand Owner; later ones join as Staff.
logins.domainNo: Email outside the brand's domain — check before approving
logins.hasOwner: The brand already has an Owner: joins as Staff

admin.title: Brand record (Groscove)
admin.hint: Only Groscove can edit. Name, category, website and email domains apply across the platform.
admin.name: Name
admin.domainsHint: Separate with commas (e.g. natura.net, natura.com.br). Anyone signing up with an email from these domains sees "Are you from this brand?". Personal email (gmail, hotmail…) never counts.
admin.internalHint: Only Groscove sees this. The brand and other agencies don't.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 1 MB, ideally with a transparent background.

claim.title: Are you from one of these brands?
claim.body: These brands are already on the platform. Request access to yours: Groscove checks and approves it. This way nobody creates the same brand twice.
claim.none: No brand found with that name.
claim.domainMatch: Your email is from this brand's domain
claim.notListed: My brand isn't here — register a new one
claim.searchAgain: Look for my brand in the list
claim.pendingBody: You asked for access to {brand}. Groscove checks and approves it; you'll get a notice in the bell.
claim.rejected: Your previous request for {brand} was not approved. If that's a mistake, ask again or contact Groscove.

brandLogo.title: Brand logo
brandLogo.hint: The logo is shown to agencies, Heroes and in your portal.
